name: Yuvraaj Bhatter
tagline: Building at the intersection of AI, iOS, and quantitative finance.
bioShort: CS student at Santa Clara University. I build small, weird, delightful software — AI systems, iOS apps, and quant research engines.
bio:
I like making things.

I'm a Computer Science student at Santa Clara University, and most of what I build sits somewhere between artificial intelligence, Apple platforms, and quantitative finance. Sometimes that means training models to predict football matches. Sometimes it means a SwiftUI app that grows a brain out of your habits. Sometimes it's a backtester trying to find out whether a trading idea was ever real.

I care about the part of engineering where the technical and the aesthetic stop being separate concerns — where a thing works well because it was designed carefully, and looks right because it was built correctly.

Still learning, still experimenting, always looking for the next thing worth building.

pillars.label: AI / ML
pillars.description: Agents, model pipelines, and applied ML — from resume-scoring agents to graph neural nets predicting the World Cup.

pillars.label: Apple Platforms
pillars.description: Swift, SwiftUI, SceneKit. Winner of Apple's Swift Student Challenge 2026 and three days at WWDC.

pillars.label: Quant Finance
pillars.description: Mean-reversion research, market-regime modelling, backtesting engines, and trading agents.
